- Window chrome/decorations — styled by your active GTK4 theme

- Dark/light mode preference

- Terminal font (set via `font-family` in Ghostty config)
- Terminal padding, opacity, keybindings — all Ghostty-only
- GTK3 themes entirely (Ghostty is GTK4)
